subject: Security onboarding questions, incident timeline & evidence delivery
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@meditrust.com>, Meditrust Security <security@meditrust.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding questions, incident timeline & evidence delivery

Hi Elena / Meditrust Security team,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and appreciate the clarity on your timelines. Per our demo & discovery, I wanted to summarize next steps on the security/compliance items we agreed to follow up on and ask for a couple things from your side so we can get evidence over to you on schedule.

Quick recap (Redwood context):
- SOC 2: We maintain a SOC 2 Type II report; summary attached. We can provide the full report under NDA or via secure link.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency controls, DPA, and a HIPAA BAA option for covered workflows. Key management via customer KMS/HSM integrations is available.
- Incident response & breach notification: Redwood's IR playbook aligns with a 72-hour initial notification window; more detail below.

Requests from Meditrust (action items we discussed):
1) Please share the vendor security questionnaire you prefer we complete (we can upload back to your portal or provide a single combined DOCX).
2) Confirm whether you require formal BAA language (HIPAA) or a DPA-only for now.
3) Any specific evidence format for BCP / DR (RTO/RPO expectations) and where to upload (SFTP / shared Drive / vendor portal).

Our deliverables & timeline (what we'll provide):
- By Mon 14 Sep: Drafted answers to your vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 summary + IR playbook excerpt + BCP/DR matrix (RTO/RPO).
- If you request the full SOC 2 report, we'll provide it under NDA or via secure share within 2 business days after NDA execution.

Attachments referenced: SOC2_summary.pdf (summary), IR_playbook_excerpt.docx, BCP_DR_matrix.xlsx.

If it's helpful, we can also provide a short recorded walk-through of the IR playbook and the logging/audit evidence.

Next steps from our side: Monica will source the SOC 2 files; Neha will compile the IR and BCP artifacts; I will draft the vendor questionnaire responses and share a single package by EOB Mon 14 Sep.

Elena — can you confirm preferred upload method and whether James or someone else will own the procurement side?

Thanks,

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0147
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@meditrust.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Meditrust Security <security@meditrust.com>
Cc: James O'Neill <j.oneill@meditrust.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding questions, incident timeline & evidence delivery

Hi Rafael — thanks for the clear summary. Meditrust can accept uploads to our secure SFTP (details below) or via a vendor portal link; SFTP is preferred for larger items. A few clarifications from our security team:

- Vendor questionnaire: Attaching our standard security vendor questionnaire (Meditrust-VSA-2025.docx). Please return completed questionnaire by Mon 14 Sep.
- BAA vs DPA: We need a signed BAA if Redwood will process PHI on our behalf. Please flag if that’s applicable for any specific workloads — otherwise DPA is sufficient for non-PHI data.
- Incident timeline: We require an initial notification within 72 hours of detection for incidents impacting PHI or regulated data, and an IR timeline (detection -> containment -> eradication -> recovery) with expected RTO/RPO per service tier.
- Evidence: For BCP/DR we expect an itemized matrix (RTO/RPO per component) and evidence of last DR test (date + summary).

Upload: sftp.meditrust.com (user: meditrust-vendor). We will create an inbound folder for Redwood once you indicate SFTP is preferred.

I'll coordinate with James on procurement logistics; he is copied.

Best,
Elena
Elena Novak
Head of Security — Meditrust Health
elena.novak@meditrust.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Novak <elena.novak@meditrust.com>, Meditrust Security <security@meditrust.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Plan to deliver Meditrust evidence (deadline Mon 14 Sep)

Monica / Neha — forwarding Elena's notes. Plan:
- Monica: please pull the signed SOC 2 Type II cover letter + scope page and SOC2_summary.pdf from the secure vault. If we need NDA before full report, indicate so. Goal: deliver summary + offer full report under NDA.
- Neha: extract the IR playbook excerpt showing detection and notification flow, and a one-page breach notification timeline (to match their 72-hour requirement). Attach as IR_playbook_excerpt.docx.
- Rafael (me): I'll fill out their vendor questionnaire and prepare the BCP_DR_matrix.xlsx with RTO/RPO fields per component (control plane, inference GPU fleet, KV cache, logging/audit retention).

Upload target: Elena prefers SFTP. I'll request the inbound folder and will upload there. If SFTP isn't created by them, we'll provide a secure Drive link.

Attachments I'll assemble: vendor_questionnaire-redwood-responses.docx (draft), SOC2_summary.pdf (from vault), IR_playbook_excerpt.docx, BCP_DR_matrix.xlsx.

Deadline: EOB Mon 2025-09-14. Please flag blockers by Fri 12 Sep EOD.

Rafael / Monica — quick status: SOC2_summary.pdf and IR_playbook_excerpt.docx are ready. I populated the BCP_DR_matrix.xlsx with our standard RTO/RPO by component and added last DR test summary (2025-06-02, tabletop + failover test).

I've uploaded the package to the SFTP folder Elena created: /inbound/Redwood_MT-2025-091/ and left a readme file explaining each artifact. Links below:
- SFTP (credentials provided to Elena separately)
- Drive fallback: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-raf-meditrust-evidence

I've also attached the draft questionnaire responses as vendor_questionnaire-redwood-responses.docx in the same folder. Rafael — please review the questionnaire answers and sign-off before I mark complete.

If there are specific redlines required in the BAA, flag now; otherwise we'll route standard BAA to legal for signature (estimate 3 business days).

-- Neha

- We'll expect the draft vendor questionnaire plus SOC2 summary for our security review; please tag the questionnaire answers where you reference specific controls.
